next_action.description: Run /mpi-flow-graphics for the Extend Video flow (id `ltx-extend` in js/data/flowsRegistry.js). Fabio supplied both clips in C:\Users\Fabio\Downloads\Exetnd (note: folder name is misspelled 'Exetnd'): i2v_ms_005.mp4 is the SOURCE (864x480, 2.334s) and flowLtxExtend_002.mp4 is the EXTENDED RESULT (864x480, 4.042s) - so the extension adds 1.708s and the source ends at 57.7% of the result. Proposed device, agreed but NOT yet built: play the result straight through with a progress rail beneath it, a marker at 57.7% where the source ended, and the rail continuing past that marker in --accent-heat so the added length is the visible payload. Confirm the two clips really are source and extension of each other (compare the first 2.334s) before building on that assumption.

key_decisions: A flow ships TWO assets: `preview` (4/5 still, tile + slide-over thumb + hero poster/fallback) and `video` (wide 8:5 or 16:9 autoplaying hero, first slide only). A flow's `video` does NOT make it a video tile the way a ModelDef's does - MpiFlowLibrary.js hardcodes media:'image' on purpose.

Hero device is chosen by WHAT CHANGES: frame content -> before/after wipe; length/motion -> show the extension running past a marker; nothing visible -> animate the changed channel. Add Foley proved the third case (a before/after there would be two identical panels).
ffmpeg alone built both shipped heroes. HyperFrames is now scoped in the playbook to heroes made of TYPE and GRAPHICS, not plates and data - it was not needed once.
Hero budget is HARD at 2MB because it autoplays on open, unlike model tiles which only play on hover (ltx23_high_preview.mp4 is 38MB). Shipped heroes are 114KB and 481KB.
GIF was rejected: the codebase already settled this at MpiOpHelpDialog.js:32 ('media is treated as a GIF that compresses better').
constraints: ffmpeg `drawbox` does NOT animate its w/h expressions in this build - it renders the full graphic from frame 1, exits 0, and looks like it worked. Build reveals with `overlay`'s x and eval=frame. A reveal cover must also be OPAQUE; a translucent one shows the un-played half straight through.
There is NO ffmpeg or ffprobe on PATH and no `bc` on this box. Use C:/AI/Mpi/video-tool/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe and the ffprobe-static beside it, and precompute derived numbers.

Judge every asset at its REAL display width - 220px tile, 446px hero. A 620px contact sheet flatters everything and twice sent an unreadable asset forward. Model output is often low-res (864x480 here) so expect an upscale; that is fine, an unreadable hero is not.
Run the `sharp` snippet from the repo root, never the scratchpad - it resolves from the script's own location and dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for an installed package.

NEVER drive :3000, that is Fabio's live app. Use `npm run app:isolated`. A forced taskkill leaves the isolated profile LOCKED (EPERM, splash fails, exit 0) - relaunch with CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE pointing at a fresh path. Kill only your own tree, found via the port's PID and its grandparent.

js/data/flowsRegistry.js is CO-OWNED with live peer sessions. Check `git diff` before committing it; a peer scratch entry marked NOT SHIPPABLE was in there this session and had to be excluded by staging a single hunk with `git apply --cached`.
